name: James son of Zebedee
title: Son of Thunder
summary: James was the son of Zebedee and brother to the apostle John. Together with Peter and John, he belonged to Jesus' innermost circle and witnessed the Transfiguration and Gethsemane. Jesus called the brothers 'sons of thunder' because of their zeal. James became the first apostle to suffer martyrdom.

keyEvents.title: The Call by the Sea
keyEvents.description: Jesus called James and John while they were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending nets. They left everything and followed him.

keyEvents.title: Sons of Thunder
keyEvents.description: Jesus gave James and John the nickname 'Boanerges', which means sons of thunder, because of their zealous temperament.

keyEvents.title: On the Mount of Transfiguration
keyEvents.description: James was one of three who saw Jesus transfigured on the mountain, along with Moses and Elijah.

keyEvents.title: Fire from heaven
keyEvents.description: When a Samaritan village rejected Jesus, James and John wanted to call down fire from heaven, but Jesus rebuked them.

keyEvents.title: Martyrdom
keyEvents.description: King Herod Agrippa had James executed by the sword—the first apostle to suffer martyrdom.
